summary: Right-clicking anything on the timeline now gives a short menu about that thing: a video clip has 11 rows in four groups (it had 21), a gap has Ripple Delete and Track, and the rest of what a clip can do is one level down under More. Rows that act at the playhead say the time, and rows that cannot act are left out instead of greyed.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open the tutorial recording with the timeline showing; add a title page and some music to try every kind.

try.do: Park the playhead at two seconds and right-click the recording's clip.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Compare it with the menu the same clip gave before this change.

evaluate: Does the clip menu now read as the things you do to that clip at that moment?
Is Split at 0:02.00 clearer than Split at Playhead when you right-click far from the playhead?
Is anything you reach for often now stuck under More?
On a gap and on empty track space, is Track ▸ the right home for the track's own settings?
Do Cut and Copy belong on the clip menu, beside Delete and Ripple Delete?
rough: The animation mock (video-animate.html, the key line's menu) leads with Animate and Add Key; here they are under More on every clip, to keep to your 2026-10-17 ask of about ten rows. Settled by decision card a-title-or-picture-right-click-leads-with-animat-should-a-title-or-picture-s-righ.

No mock draws a clip's right-click besides the animation one: the Clip sections of video.html and video-cut-wt.html are the page's command menu, and they match (Split, Detach Audio, Ripple Delete with their keys).
Freeze Frame is still a submenu of fixed lengths; asking how long is its own task (freeze-frame-asks-how-long-and-inserts-a-freeze).
Rows that act at the playhead print the time, so walks name the exact moment (Split at 0:02.02) and a ruler click a frame off changes the words.
The track header's own menu is unchanged, including its greyed Zoom to Fit, and it is what Track ▸ opens.
A walk's right click on a caption line used to raise no menu at all, and a second one came up blank; both now give the line's own menu.
